item.title: Researchers Turn USB Auto-Install Into a Full SYSTEM Takeover on Windows 11
item.summary: Windows Plug and Play can be abused to fetch signed vendor software for an emulated USB device and execute privileged installation components that researchers chained to SYSTEM access on a fully updated Windows 11 machine.
